wa_south_spur.overview: Whatcom Peak's easier, more commonly-climbed south side (4th class, PG13 — real exposure on otherwise moderate terrain). It's normally reached from Perfect Pass, either via the long Easy Ridge traverse out of Hannegan Pass, or by a lower traversing line ('low orbit') around the peak's east side directly from Whatcom Pass.

wa_davis_peak_nc_north_face.fa: Dallas Kloke and Bryce Simon, July 1974 or 1976 (the year is recorded both ways). First winter ascent (to the summit ridge): Stuart Taylor and Ade Miller, March 13, 2005
